full_prompt_en: A square illustrated interior scene shows a dark-haired woman reclining in an ornate upholstered chair before a pale golden arched opening. She occupies most of the center and lower frame, with one long black-clad leg angled from the lower left toward a raised knee near the middle. Her body leans slightly right. One arm bends upward so her hand supports the side of her head, while the other rests over the carved arm of the chair. Her eyes are closed, and her lips are dark red, giving the face a quiet, weary expression. Black curls frame the cheeks and gather at the back of her head. She wears a pale cream wrap-like blouse with a deep folded neckline and sleeves that slip down the arms; a small pendant rests at the chest. Dark decorative marks are visible on the upper arms. The chair is covered in warm rose-brown fabric with scrolling motifs, its curved arms and cushion filling the lower right and lower center. Behind her, a wide cream arch glows softly, bordered by intricate gold line work near the upper corners. A narrow vertical panel at the left contains faded ornamental imagery, while a cooler gray-blue column or hanging surface frames the right side. Fine black outlines give the face, clothing folds, and furniture a confident drawn structure. Soft watercolor-like fills and slightly granular printed texture keep the warm gold and brown areas from appearing flat. Pale gold light from the arched background illuminates the face, blouse, and upper arms, while the black leg and hair provide the strongest shadow shapes. No readable text appears. The overall composition combines a relaxed diagonal pose with formal decorative framing, creating a warm, intimate scene whose elegant line work remains lively beneath the stillness.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形室内插画：黑发女子斜倚在华丽的软包椅上，身后是浅金色拱形开口。她占据中央与下方大部分画面，一条穿黑色裤袜的长腿从左下斜向中央抬起的膝盖。身体略向右靠。一只手臂向上弯，手托着头的一侧；另一只手放在椅子雕饰扶手上。她闭着眼，嘴唇深红，面容安静而略带疲惫。黑色卷发围住脸颊，在脑后聚拢。她穿浅奶油色裹身式上衣，领口深而折叠，袖子滑落到手臂；胸前有一枚小吊坠。上臂可见深色装饰图案。椅面是暖玫瑰褐色布料，带卷草纹样，弯曲扶手和坐垫填满右下与下方中央。身后宽阔奶油色拱形柔和发亮，上角附近有精细金线边饰。左侧一道窄竖面板内有褪色装饰图像，右侧则由较冷的灰蓝色柱面或悬垂表面框住。细黑轮廓赋予面容、衣褶和家具自信的手绘结构。类似水彩的柔色填充和略带颗粒的印刷肌理使暖金与褐色区域不显平板。浅金光从拱形背景方向照亮脸、上衣和上臂，黑色长腿与头发则提供最强阴影形状。画中没有可读文字。整体构图把放松的斜向姿态与正式装饰框架结合，形成温暖而亲密的场景，优雅线条在静止中仍保持活力。
style_prompt_en: Decorative illustration combines confident dark contour drawing with soft, lightly granular fields of cream, gold, rose-brown, and charcoal. Curved ornamental borders and scrolling motifs frame broad pale openings, while a strong dark diagonal balances the softer warm areas. The focal forms have precise facial and fabric lines, but color inside the outlines transitions gently rather than appearing as rigid flat fill. Repeated curls and arches give the composition an elegant rhythm. Warm diffuse light lifts the cream and gold planes, leaving dark areas as clean graphic anchors. The overall effect is intimate, ornate, and quietly theatrical, with drawn precision softened by painterly color.
style_prompt_zh: 装饰性插画把自信的深色轮廓线与带轻微颗粒的奶油色、金色、玫瑰褐和炭灰色域结合。弯曲装饰边框与卷草纹样框住宽阔浅色开口，一条有力深色斜线平衡较柔软的暖色区域。焦点形体的面部与布料线条准确，但轮廓内部色彩轻柔过渡，并非僵硬的平涂。重复卷线和拱弧赋予构图优雅节奏。暖漫射光提亮奶油与金色平面，让深色区域成为干净的图形锚点。整体效果亲密、华丽而安静地带着舞台感，手绘准确性被绘画色彩柔化。
theme_en: A dark-haired woman reclining in an ornate chair beneath a golden arch
theme_zh: 黑发女子斜倚华丽椅中，背后是金色拱形
name: Leone Frollo
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
